HOW IT WORKS

Skip the search - Hire vetted GTM operators

At The Kiln, our internal agency is made up of the best GTMEs in the world. We know exactly what to look for.

1. Initial Approach

You reach out, and we align on your hiring needs — whether it’s scaling fast, filling a gap, or bringing in GTM leadership. No wasted time.

2. Description of Role Criteria

You share what matters most: role requirements, challenges to solve, and cultural fit. This ensures we target the right candidates.

3. Candidate Selection

We handpick top GTM engineers from our vetted network, interview them, and ensure they’re qualified before presenting them to you.

4. Company-Candidate Fit

You interview shortlisted candidates to confirm skills and cultural alignment. We keep the process fast, simple, and focused.

5. Candidate Hired

Once you hire, we can also provide onboarding and training (optional) to ensure your GTM executive hits the ground running.
